# The pinned files of the GNU layer that are not ports: the sources of the
# programs that the scripts under native/, spidermonkey/ and chromium/ build,
# the Debian archive keys, and the CA bundle that the GNU system's image
# installs. Each line gives a name, version, URL and SHA-256, in the format
# of sources.txt. fetch.sh reads both lists and checks both alike. GDB's
# tarball is pinned in sources.txt, with the ports.
#
# Each digest was recorded after the upstream signature verified: Mozilla's
# release key, 14F26682D0916CDD81E37B6D61B7B526D98F0353, for Firefox's
# source, whose signed SHA256SUMS lists the same digest; and the Rust
# release key, 108F66205EAEB0AAA8DD5E1C85AB96E6FA1BE5FE, for the Rust
# components. cbindgen's crate has no signature: its digest is the one the
# crates.io index lists, and the crate records the git revision from which
# Firefox's automation builds cbindgen. The Debian archive keys have the
# fingerprints ftp-master publishes, and Ubuntu's debian-archive-keyring
# package has the same ones.
#
# The CA bundle is curl's extract of Mozilla's root store as Mozilla last
# changed it, on 2026-09-25: 121 certificates in PEM form. It has no
# signature. Its digest is the one curl.se publishes beside it, and its
# certificates were checked against their source. The bundle's header gives
# the SHA-256 of the certdata.txt it was made from,
# beb7e6dfe6499926e52c075c27bcfbe4c957f8609c575b3860273ae2806f63eb, and the
# certdata.txt on the release branch of Mozilla's firefox repository on
# GitHub had that digest on 2026-09-27; mk-ca-bundle.pl from the verified
# curl 8.22.0 tarball, run on that file, wrote the same certificates line
# for line.
